decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core dosimetry business that stayed on the home page in both 2023 and 2024, it carries visible commitment and strong strategic fit, so management is unlikely to withdraw it.

The oncology risk management software builds directly on the firm's integration and automation strategy, and its continued standalone presentation supports continued commitment despite any early commercial uncertainty.
This CT image quality phantom fits the firm's established medical imaging QA capabilities and is still too new for weak uptake to outweigh the investment already made.

Although this mammography phantom is more distant from the historical core offer, it has already been launched publicly and management in an expanding firm would likely give it more time before admitting a strategic mistake.

This full field mammography test phantom is also outside the firm's main established line, but the recent launch and sunk development and marketing effort make near-term withdrawal less likely than continued testing of the market.
Medical imaging QA instruments are well aligned with the firm's stated direction around measurement and integrated QA, so management is likely to retain the product while scaling adoption.
